mapper.sql: a.id, a.applicant_user_id AS applicantUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(applicant.display_name, ''), applicant.username) AS applicantName, a.form_id AS formId, a.form_key AS formKey, a.form_name AS formName, a.title, a.data_json AS dataJson, a.status, a.version, task.id AS taskId, task.version AS taskVersion, task.status AS taskStatus, task.due_at AS taskDueAt, assignee.id AS taskAssigneeUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(assignee.display_name, ''), assignee.username) AS taskAssigneeName, instance.status AS workflowStatus, a.workflow_instance_id AS workflowInstanceId, a.submitted_at AS submittedAt, a.completed_at AS completedAt, a.created_at AS createdAt, a.updated_at AS updatedAt

JOIN app_user applicant ON applicant.id = a.applicant_user_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT wt.id, wt.version, wt.status, wt.due_at, wt.assignee_user_id FROM workflow_task wt WHERE wt.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND wt.business_type = 'GENERIC_APPROVAL' AND wt.business_id = a.id ORDER BY wt.created_at DESC, wt.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) task ON TRUE LEFT JOIN app_user assignee ON assignee.id = task.assignee_user_id LEFT JOIN workflow_instance instance ON instance.id = a.workflow_instance_id AND instance.tenant_id = a.tenant_id
mapper.select: SELECT ur.user_id FROM user_role ur JOIN app_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND u.status = 1 WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.role_code = #{roleCode} AND ur.user_id <> #{excludeUserId} ORDER BY ur.user_id LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM workflow_definition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND code = 'GENERIC_FORM_APPROVAL' AND enabled = TRUE ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
